messages:
ivy (Docs): quick sync: i'm refreshing the Quickstart hello guide in PR #5220. noticed we still show 8080 in the deploy step but the starter image listens on 8081 now. also want to standardize the auth snippet to use env-based tokens. thoughts?

ben (DevEx): agree on env-first examples. use REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere. for the port, update the Dockerfile example + the `docker run -p 8081:8081` command. we should add a tiny troubleshooting sentence about 404s mapping to wrong ports.

kai (Eng): i'll update starter-template to expose 8081 and default PORT=8081 in the run script. will push a commit and link it to the PR.

iry (Docs): (typo) — ivy.

ruth (QA): when you update the example, can you add a curl healthcheck example so reviewers can quickly validate locally? `curl -f http://localhost:8081/health` is enough.

preview-bot: preview build for PR #5220 finished: https://preview.example/5220. linkcheck: 0 broken links.

ivy (Docs): added curl snippet and swapped snippets to `const client = new Redwood()` / `client = new Client()` patterns that read env. kept a short migration note for SDK vX -> vY.

bен (DevEx): small nit: use `REDWOOD_API_KEY` consistently in both Node and Python snippets; also avoid inline keys in examples.

kai (Eng): starter-template updated (commit f3a9c). deploy script now accepts `--port`. linked in PR description.

ruth (QA): smoke-tested preview, health endpoint responds on 8081, curl works, one copy nit: replace "press enter" with "press Enter".

ivy (Docs): fixed the copy nit, squashed, and pushed. ready for review. tagging ben and kai.

bен (DevEx): approved. thanks!

kai (Eng): approved. merging once CI passes.

ivy (Docs): merged PR #5220. leaving follow-up issue to add a CI deploy example for GH Actions that sets REDWOOD_API_KEY as a secret. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
